review_scope: Selected eclipse interpretation in hash-verified cached QLP SAP, with bounded follow-up where decisive.
evidence: Across 37 available sectors the flagged windows sit amid large orbit-related ramps, resets and brightenings. The largest selected deficit, 62 ppt at 2047.83 in S27, falls immediately before a 2048.080–2049.170 d gap and a flux-level change. The S68 3162.61 broad flag occurs in another strong ramp; flagged brightenings in S27/S38 reach tens of ppt in the same unstable context.
interpretation: The selected dip statistics are produced by nonstationary baseline and orbit-edge behavior rather than repeated isolated eclipses.
limitations: This is a refutation of selected windows, not a proof that the target cannot eclipse at some other time. No reliable eclipse clock is measured.
catalogue_status: UNKNOWN; VSX, ASAS-SN, Kostov table 3/4 unavailable
